headline: Netflix launches AI Discover tab for mood-based watch recommendations
summary: Netflix has introduced a new AI Discover tab designed to help users find something to watch based on their current mood. The first experimental feature under the tab offers recommendations drawn from a range of AI-generated themes.

claims.statement: Netflix launched a new AI Discover tab to help users find something to watch based on their mood.
